cards.name: Robin: Reluctant Adieu
cards.text: 【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over 4 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, you may draw 1 card.

cards.name: Red Robin: Battle on the Big Boat
cards.text: 【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 1500, Level 1 [Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose 1 of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn)

cards.name: Gunslinger
cards.text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to 1 red card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.

cards.name: Batman: Missionary Disguise
cards.text: 【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.

cards.name: Nightwing: Coordinated Assault
cards.text: 【AUTO】 Bond/"Catwoman: Battle on the Big Boat" [(1)] (When this card is played and placed on stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 card named "Catwoman: Battle on the Big Boat" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)

cards.name: Batman: Ancient Armor
cards.text: 【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 When this card attacks, if "Unleash the Bat!" is in your climax area, you may draw 1 card.

cards.name: Batman: Information Extraction
cards.text: 【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)

cards.name: Catwoman: Battle on the Big Boat
Batman: Infiltration
cards.text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room.

cards.name: Donning the Mask
cards.text: Look at up to 4 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 《Weapon》 character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room.

cards.name: Unleash the Bat!
cards.text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.
